title: THE GATE BREACH NEEDS THE HOLD AND THE GARRISON STAYS IN THE HOUSE
why: His order: hold-to-breach door, he did not have to hold, then got slaughtered by crawlers. Breach must really need the hold, and the enemies in breach houses should not leave the house. The gate ring now fills only while E (or the pad search button) is held at the gate, and after the breach the defenders of that building are kept inside its walls.
now: Hold E at a stronghold gate to breach it, and its garrison stays in the house.
